decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for B1(c) use purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 8.30 to 1800 Monday to Friday and outside of 10.00 to 14.00 on Saturdays. The premise shall not be open on Sundays or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for B1(c) and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - The use hereby approved shall not without the written consent of the Local Planning Authority increase the 35m2 show room area located on the ground floor
description: Change of use from B8 (Storage and distribution) to B1(c) (Light industry)
